articles.title: Exact Spectral Majorants for a Wilson–Dirac Interval

edits.old_markdown: Decay of the longitudinal modular term and convergence of the nonlinear finite part still require separate estimates; the full constant-term expansion remains conditional. The present paper owns the projector, pairing, and positive-tail inputs, not those further convergence claims.
edits.new_markdown: For the specified compressed infinite-chain Wilson model at fixed $\mu>0$, the additional convergence estimates and full constant-term expansion are established in *Finite Part of Wilson–Dirac Relative Entropy*, Theorem 1 and its proof, and sharpened in *Uniform Modular Control and Nonlinear Convergence for Wilson–Dirac Intervals*, Theorem 3, Corollary 4 and Theorem 6. Their exact concentration-connection and boundary inputs remain those stated in those papers. The present paper supplies the projector, pairing, and positive-tail inputs.

edits.new_tex: For the specified compressed infinite-chain Wilson model at fixed \(\mu>0\), the additional convergence estimates and full constant-term expansion are established in \emph{Finite Part of Wilson--Dirac Relative Entropy}, Theorem 1 and its proof, and sharpened in \emph{Uniform Modular Control and Nonlinear Convergence for Wilson--Dirac Intervals}, Theorem 3, Corollary 4 and Theorem 6. Their exact concentration-connection and boundary inputs remain those stated in those papers. The present paper supplies the projector, pairing, and positive-tail inputs.

articles.title: Fourth-Moment Control of the Wilson Nonlinear Correction

edits.old_markdown: A bound \(\|E_N\|=O(1)\) over the full reference spectrum remains open.
edits.new_markdown: Theorem 3 of *Uniform Modular Control and Nonlinear Convergence for Wilson–Dirac Intervals* proves $\|E_N\|\le7$ for every even $N\ge2$, under the exact concentration connection specified there. This later result is separate from the reduction proved above.
edits.new_tex: Theorem 3 of \emph{Uniform Modular Control and Nonlinear Convergence for Wilson--Dirac Intervals} proves \(\|E_N\|\le7\) for every even \(N\ge2\), under the exact concentration connection specified there. This later result is separate from the reduction proved above.

articles.title: From Prephysical Hypotheses to Physical Models

edits.old_markdown: The conclusions concern interval restrictions of infinite-chain projectors and do not provide a moving-edge expansion, a general-filling theorem, or uniformity for shrinking scaled mass.
edits.new_markdown: The results concern interval restrictions of infinite-chain projectors. Conditional additive uniformity on bounded scaled masses is Proposition 7 of *Calibration, identified sets and uniform limits*; relative vanishing-mass, moving-edge and general-filling limits remain separate.
